Midday          = Mon-Fri 10:00-15:00
Afternoon Drive = Mon-Fri 15:00-19:00
Evening         = 19:00-24:00 (all days)
Weekend         = Sat-Sun 08:00-18:00NOTES FOR TESTING CONFLICTSBoth Auto customers (Thunderbay + WaveRider) are locked to Morning Drive → direct competition.
Both Restaurants locked to Afternoon Drive → direct competition.
Both Retail locked to Midday → direct competition.
Both Real Estate locked to Weekend → direct competition.
Bank + Grocery also prefer Morning Drive (extra pressure on that daypart).
Dental + Telecom also prefer Midday.
Legal + Insurance also prefer Afternoon Drive.
Resort is the only one in pure Evening for isolation testing.

AudioRef values match the script lengths created earlier.
You can rename the actual .wav/.mp3 files to match these AudioRef names when you generate them.
